question: Translate fixed L2 industry targets into nominal member concentration and structural target changes

risk: known-stock HHI and largest known weight; conservative total HHI [knownHHI,knownHHI+2*maxKnown*unknown+unknown^2] and maxweight [maxKnown,maxKnown+unknown], capped at1. Bounds not imputation
turnover: R76 target-to-target structural distance bounds max(0,knownL1-u-v),min(2,knownL1+u+v); compare industry target L1, consecutive months only summaries; no drift/price/actual execution claim
scope: Nominal historical member mapping, not actual priced basket or executable holdings; taxonomies separate; no adoption or strict PIT
